name: Deep Sentence
summary: A d6 against an opponent's Power: win it, the Abyss; lose it, −2 Power.

face.name: Deep Sentence

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Choose an opposing Entity and roll a d6: if the result is equal to or higher than its Power, put it into the Abyss; otherwise that Entity gets −2 Power until end of turn.

face.flavor: The deep doesn't argue. It weighs.
